failure_units.denominator: structure replacement cost new of the same reference building (no land, contents, site works or depreciation)
failure_units.source_atom_note: Whole-building source-native depth-damage function; not an aggregate of component records.

included: still-water inundation of the building from riverine, pluvial or coastal-surge flooding
excluded: wave impact, high-velocity flow, scour and debris (deferred pathway flood_wave_velocity; withheld, not zero)
contents, business interruption, land, site works
mould and long-duration effects beyond what the source curves embed
hazard_scope.compound_event_rule: Charge one building value once per event across flood pathways and other perils.

hazard_axis.extrapolation_policy: record-level ranges govern: Hazus records -4 to 24 ft, retail coastal record -1 to 10 ft; below a record range returns 0; above withholds
hazard_axis.bridge: flood_depth_above_first_floor_ft = flood_depth_above_grade_ft - first_floor_height_ft; depth above grade <= 0 is not inundated (DR 0); a consumer sending floor-relative depth applies the dry rule itself

pathways.record_routing_note: Warehouse DF341 only; same source atom for freshwater and coastal still water. No retail, office or house fallback.

selector_logic.effect: Fixed identity of the reference building; picks the occupancy-specific record.

conditioner_logic.effect: Event-time state. House, warehouse and office: same Hazus record for both types. Retail: Hazus (freshwater) or NACCS (coastal surge), never blended.

exposure_contract.value_rule: Scenario dollars need structure replacement cost new for the same building; the consumer qualifies the reference budget.
exposure_contract.protection_rule: Flood protection must already be reflected in the delivered depth; no curve-side credit.

curve_records.extrapolation_policy: below -4 ft returns 0 (published zero region); above 24 ft withholds; no clamp

value_linkage.curve_denominator: structure replacement cost new of the reference building

parameter_tier_table.value: flood depth above first finished floor, ft
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: Native axis of both libraries (FRE-C001).
parameter_tier_table.update_trigger: A source with a different reference elevation is adopted.

parameter_tier_table.value: straight lines between published points (piecewise linear)
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: Reproduces every published value; smooth fits predict held-out points worse on all six point curves and move published values by 2-5 points (FORM_COMPARISON); table-based cells (flood_solar, flood_wind, wildfire_solar, wildfire_wind) use straight lines; method rule: simplest form the evidence yields.
parameter_tier_table.update_trigger: A reviewed reason to prefer smoothness.

parameter_tier_table.value: depth_above_floor = depth_above_grade − first_floor_height (same datum required)
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: Both libraries define depth relative to FFE; FFE = grade + first-floor height.
parameter_tier_table.update_trigger: Hazard supplies depth on a different reference.

parameter_tier_table.value: Hazus DF 129, −4 to 24 ft (USACE-IWR)
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: FEMA Table 5-2 default; equals rounded USACE EGM means −2 to 16 ft (FRE-C002, C004).
parameter_tier_table.update_trigger: NFIP claims comparison or a Hazus Table 5-2 change.

parameter_tier_table.value: Hazus DF 217, −4 to 24 ft (USACE Galveston, average of 47 retail classes)
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: FEMA Table 5-2 default for COM1; verified identical to USACE copy (FRE-C003). Single-district provenance (FRE-C011).
parameter_tier_table.update_trigger: Owner selects office (DF 431) or NFIP comparison shows bias.

parameter_tier_table.value: Hazus DF 341, −4 to 24 ft (USACE Galveston, average of 22 wholesale/warehouse classes)
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: FEMA Table 5-2 default for COM2 (warehouse use); verified identical to USACE copy (FRE-C003). Single-district provenance.
parameter_tier_table.update_trigger: Owner selects light industrial (DF 559) or NFIP comparison shows bias.

parameter_tier_table.value: NACCS RES1-1SNB Min/ML/Max at −1, −0.5, 0, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10 ft
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: Prototype 5A matches the reference house (FRE-C007). North Atlantic expert panel; own verification found it low (FRE-C009). T3 transfer outside the North Atlantic.
parameter_tier_table.update_trigger: Attachment G review, NFIP comparison, or owner selects FEMA DF 658.

parameter_tier_table.value: NACCS COM-ENG Min/ML/Max at the ten published depths
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: Prototype 2 steel-framed commercial matches the reference building (FRE-C008). T3 transfer outside the North Atlantic.
parameter_tier_table.update_trigger: Commercial reference redefined as masonry (then COM-PRE) or NFIP comparison.

parameter_tier_table.value: NACCS COM-PRE Min/ML/Max at the ten published depths
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: Prototype 3 one-story steel/light-metal building matches the warehouse (FRE-C008). T3 transfer outside the North Atlantic.

parameter_tier_table.value: ML is the point curve; Min and Max are building-variant bounds, not a probability spread
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: NACCS defines Min/Max by building characteristics, not by probability.

parameter_tier_table.value: published depths only: −1, −0.5, 0, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10 ft
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: Compiled values at 4, 6, 8, 9 ft are fills (FRE-C006, D-FRE-13).

parameter_tier_table.value: −4 to 24 ft; below −4 ft = 0%; above 24 ft withholds
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: Published library range; every record is 0% at −4 ft; no extrapolation or clamp above (D-FRE-21, flood_wind precedent).

parameter_tier_table.value: −1 to 10 ft; below −1 ft = 0%; above 10 ft withholds
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: Published report range; every NACCS curve is 0% at −1 ft; no extrapolation or clamp above (D-FRE-21).

parameter_tier_table.value: freshwater -> Hazus; coastal_surge_saline -> NACCS; unknown -> withhold
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: Libraries built for different water and settings; FEMA's own coastal position recorded as alternative (FRE-C013).
parameter_tier_table.update_trigger: Owner selects FEMA coastal defaults, or Hazard cannot supply water type.

parameter_tier_table.value: 0.75 ft above grade
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: NSI 2026 documented RES1 slab default (FRE-C022); replaces the NACCS 5A 1.0 ft (D-FRE-22).
parameter_tier_table.update_trigger: NSI documents non-residential defaults, or owner choice.

parameter_tier_table.value: 0.25 ft above grade
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: NSI records, slab COM1/COM4 in three counties (FRE-C023); not documented; replaces NACCS Prototype 2 0 ft.
parameter_tier_table.update_trigger: NSI documents non-residential defaults, or owner choice.

parameter_tier_table.value: 0.25 ft above grade
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: NSI records, slab COM2/IND2 in three counties (FRE-C023); not documented; replaces NACCS Prototype 3 1.0 ft.
parameter_tier_table.update_trigger: NSI documents non-residential defaults, or owner choice.

parameter_tier_table.value: structure replacement cost new (no land, contents, depreciation)
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: Both libraries express damage as % of structure value (FRE-C001).
parameter_tier_table.update_trigger: Owner chooses another reporting basis (explicit conversion only).

parameter_tier_table.value: not set
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: Four options documented (NSI fullrep, Hazus 7.0 Inventory TM, RSMeans, team values); none selected; scenario dollars withheld (D-FRE-23).
parameter_tier_table.update_trigger: A named replacement-cost source is adopted.

parameter_tier_table.value: not adjusted
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: Coastal reads below freshwater for the house and two to three times above for commercial and warehouse at 4 ft (pressure test §3); no uplift applied.

evaluation_contract.out_of_range_behavior: above a record's highest published depth: withhold; below its lowest: 0

emit_contract.supported_output: conditional scalar DR for FRE_BUILDING_STRUCTURE; the retail coastal record adds NACCS Min/Max building-variant bounds
emit_contract.scenario_loss: withheld until the consumer qualifies the building value
emit_contract.withheld_units_emit: explicit null DR plus reason codes; never zero

Hazard frequency, coupling, value, cap and missing-mass gates before annual use

derivation_rationale.source_spine: FEMA Hazus 7.0 Table 5-2 structure defaults (house RES1, warehouse COM2, office COM4, retail COM1) for still water; USACE NACCS 2015 prototype 2 for retail coastal surge only. Verified against originals and independent copies; compared with NFIP claims (FRE-S012).
derivation_rationale.adopted_form: exact published tables, straight lines between published points
derivation_rationale.why_one_curve_for_both_waters: NFIP coastal-surge claims are closer to the Hazus curves than to NACCS for the house and multi-floor business buildings (FRE-C027, C029, C035); FEMA assigns DF 341 and DF 431 to coastal zones (FRE-C033); D-FRE-28.
derivation_rationale.why_not_smooth_fits: Smooth fits (incl. anchored logistic) predicted held-out points worse on all point curves and moved published values by 2-6 points.
derivation_rationale.parameter_tier_mix: Ordinates T2 with stated transfer limits; first-floor heights T2 (house) and T3 (commercial, warehouse, office); value coverage not itemized by the sources.
